description: Phase-MODERNIZE — infrastructure hygiene + Wave-1 god-file splits. 3-scout research 2026-05-22 (docs/research-2026-05-22/{module-hygiene-2026-state-of-art,dtmp-module-shape-survey,...}.md) + per-module audit surfaced: Aura has 50+ modules, 71k LOC internal, 28 god files >500 LOC (8 violate the 600 cap), 103 dupl clusters, but 0 unused symbols and 6 TODO total (Aura is genuinely clean on dead-code/TODO). userStories.title: depguard v2 enforcing prd.md §9 forbidden dependency rules
userStories.description: Add .golangci.yml with depguard v2 strict-mode rules from prd.md §9. Forbidden imports: agent → channels/*, agent → api, agent → telegram, memory → channels/*, storage → agent, learning → channels/*, rag → channels/*, tools → chat. CI fails on new violation. Existing violations (audited at story start) are baselined via //nolint:depguard // pre-existing — track in MODULE-HEALTH per offending import. Tracked file `docs/depguard-baseline-2026-05-22.md` lists every grandfathered violation with module → offending import → reason → planned-fix story. (a) Read prd.md §9 in full to capture every forbidden direction. (b) Audit current violations by running depguard with new config; record the count + sites BEFORE adding nolint comments. (c) Add nolint comments with the file:line + reason. (d) Wire CI failure on NEW violations only (--new-from-rev=HEAD~1).

userStories.notes: GROUND-TRUTH: (1) read prd.md §9 Dependency Rules in full. (2) check existing .golangci.yml. (3) audit current violations FIRST (count + sites) before adding nolint — the baseline file must be complete. SCOPE: linter wiring only, no code fixes. Code fixes are in other stories.

userStories.title: File-size linter caps at 600 LOC + grandfather baseline
userStories.description: Custom shell script (or GitHub Action) in CI that fails on any non-test, non-generated .go file >600 LOC. Existing 28 violators grandfathered via .file-size-baseline.txt listing path + current LOC. CI fails only when a file in baseline GROWS, or a new file appears >600 LOC. Generated files (*_gen.go, web/dist) excluded. (a) Write the script. (b) Run it against current tree to produce the baseline. (c) Wire into CI. (d) Add bypass mechanism for legit large files (e.g. test fixtures): `// file-size-exempt: <reason>` comment.
